touches.text: The shim always starts its device. Nothing else does.

COMMANDS: cairn librarian ask <question> (or just cairn librarian <question>, 9.4.1); cairn librarian read <file|url|book> [for <device>/<question>]; cairn librarian research "<topic>" [for <device>/<question>].

A bare `cairn librarian` never prints URLs. It (1) launches the librarian's shim, which (2) parses the request (nothing) and so (3) launches the librarian and (4) launches a browser pointed at the librarian's chat page. That http request arrives at the web server's shim, which launches the web server, which then displays the librarian's page with focus on the chat window. Each part is self-initializing (Q#30, Akien 2026-11-06).
WHY: Cairn has a user; the operator, and the librarian's chat, need a web face.

open_questions.text: The bus feed is "on the bus' web panel" (5.4.2.7). The bus is a Cairn machine, not a device: its pane sits inside the Cairn device's page?
